./artifacts/plos-runtime/PLOS_DECISIONS.md:3:- 2026-06-13: AMB-698 / PLOS-076 defines `AbstractCoverageRequest` as an optional, consented, abstract request for reusable public coverage, not remote personalization, cloud-authored personal planning, or transport implementation. A request can be built only from an AMB-697 CoverageNeed with `remote_abstract_allowed` privacy class, explicit revocable local consent, and redaction proof. Allowed payload fields stay abstract; raw private goal text, exact schedules, proof, names, relationship context, sensitive notes, precise private location, identifiers, local learning, support data, logs, and secrets are forbidden.
